title: QuestionAnsweredData
description: data of question.answered (PRD 9.5). answered_by default means the card timed out and the Director applied its safe default; that event has severity nudge (BQ-04, EV-08). Gates never time out to go. answered_by decision means a repeat question was answered from an earlier decision (FR-AGT-07), and decision_id cites it (decision.schema.json id, rule DC-04); decision_id is set exactly then and is null or absent otherwise (added in 1.1.0).
